label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3 a.1…: The first being, to which nothing else is simply…
locator: I q.3 a.1 co., second proof: necesse est id quod est primum ens, esse in actu, et nullo modo in potentia
interpretation: 'Primum ens' is read as a being to which nothing other is simply prior. Only 'nullo modo in potentia' is formalized; 'esse in actu' is not needed by q.3 a.2-a.7. Derived in result AQUINAS-ST-I-Q3-A1-FIRST-BEING-NO-POTENCY from the act-priority premise and the prima via's non-simultaneity premise.
